# Initialize Repository

This feature initializes a repository by upgrading the schema, writing the repository configuration to a kc.toml file, and registering the repository with specified parameters. It ensures that the repository is set up correctly for subsequent operations.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.init_repository`
